name: Webot
description: Webot is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange operating across 48 U.S. states and the European Economic Area (EEA), offering a compliant and secure trading environment for retail and professional users. The platform is dual-licensed, holding FinCEN MSB registration (NMLS #2284360) in the United States and MiCA authorization through the Central Bank of Ireland (Ref C496936), positioning it within both major regulatory frameworks. Webot places strong emphasis on transparency and asset protection. The platform integrates on-chain monitoring through Chainalysis, while maintaining consistent Proof of Reserves reporting using Merkle-Tree verification, published weekly since early 2023. Over four years of operation, Webot reports no security incidents, highlighting its focus on safeguarding user funds. Webot also streamlines fiat and crypto access by eliminating the need for bridges or wrapped assets. Users can fund accounts via ACH transfers, bank cards, or direct crypto on- and off-ramps, with infrastructure tailored to meet the compliance standards of both U.S. and EEA markets.
